annotation_elapsed.basis: workflow launch to last chunk result (file timestamps), 30 chunks run in parallel; per-frame agent time is not isolated

caveats: annotated_image_zone is the plate-plane homography applied to a point that is not on the plane (the mitt sits above the plate): u is roughly the lateral position in plate widths, v is not a height and is ill-conditioned because the plate is only a few pixels tall in this camera; plate_feet needs a separate calibration (M2).
points come from assistant visual estimates with no human review and no measured accuracy; accuracy_estimate stays null until measured on an independent sample.
